whatIsIt.eli5: Turns the scores into percentages and picks the biggest.
whatIsIt.simple: Softmax turns the class scores into probabilities that add up to 1; the highest one is the answer.
whatIsIt.engineer: softmax over nc logits; top-1 / top-5 reported.

whyExists.eli5: Percentages are easier to read than raw scores.
whyExists.simple: Probabilities are comparable and easy to threshold.
whyExists.engineer: Normalises logits for interpretation and top-k metrics.
